text: そこを　バッチリ　みせちゃう　からね！

structure.jp: みせちゃう　からね！
structure.en: I'll go and show you, okay!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short, chatty form of てしまう, which says the thing gets done all the way. Here it sounds playful. みせちゃう = 'I'll go right ahead and show you'.

patterns.name: 〜からね
patterns.span: みせちゃう　からね
patterns.explanation: からね at the end of a sentence does not mean 'because' here; it is a friendly way of announcing what you are going to do. みせちゃう　からね = 'I'm going to show you, all right!'.
